name: Jannis Koberg
headline: Physics student in Kiel, writing software for simulations and lab data.
bio: So far that has meant animating radiative transfer simulations of protoplanetary disks and building tools for research data in photon and neutron science. Right now I'm teaching myself machine learning on Raman spectra. Mostly in Python, C and Rust, programming since 2020.

now.label: Building an ML study of Raman detection limits
